'''Robert Waygood HB Squadron Assignments''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Robert Waygood]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-8600">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8600 HB Squadron Assignments], DeckTech (Robert "Djas Phur" Waygood, 22 July 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8600/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8600/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018150755/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8600/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Robert Waygood]]
* '''Published:''' 22 July 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''HB Squadron Assignments''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Strategy:''' Through the use of the new DS II uncommon, Squadron Assignments, this deck is an enjoyable HB that see's many of the classic films favourites flying around in their personal snubfighter.

== Original post ==

'''HB Squadron Assignments'''
* '''Author:''' Robert "Djas Phur" Waygood
* '''Published:''' July 22, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Through the use of the new DS II uncommon, Squadron Assignments, this deck is an enjoyable HB that see's many of the classic films favourites flying around in their personal snubfighter.

=== Strategy ===

With the onslaught of Death Star II and my incoming box sometime during the next week I felt the need to wet my appetite with 7 boosters of the recently released expansion. Some great packs appeared themselves to me, with my rare cards (Luke's Lightsaber, Darth Vader's Lightsaber, Sim Aloo, Myn Kyneugh, B-Wing Attack Squadron, Judicator, and First Officer Thaneespi) I am still unable to make a purely Death Star II oriented deck, so I came to the conclusion that I'd make decks using a variety, however small, of the new commons and uncommons I have come into possession of. Onto the strategy of my deck. I use the gametext of 'Squadron Assignments' to set up my starships / characters and the gametext of HB to get my systems out, I flip my objective, have fun, and whoop ass.
